name: Ancestral Hex (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Ancestors Patron

Major Hex: When communing with her familiar to prepare spells, the witch spends 1 additional minute to talk to all the witches that came before her and learns one of their hexes. The witch gains the use of one of the hexes or major hexes from any other witch patron. She has access to this hex until the next time the witch communes with her familiar to regain spells.
